thread:
Jordan: Heads-up — prepping renewal QBR for Helix (Enterprise). Main asks: token runway, onboarding spend, and any immediate renewal risk signals. Want a short deck + 2 actionable remediation plays by EOD Friday.

Alyssa: Got it. I'll pull current usage slices and onboarding milestones. Do we have the latest spend alarm triggers? :alarm_clock:

Mike: tagging in budget/committed numbers — Helix is on a consumption plan (no commit). Monthly avg spend last 30d = $41,200. Current forecast for next 90d with growth = $128k. Token burn ~125M tokens/month (est).

Luis: FYI finance flagged a payment lag; sent renewal risk flag if spend > $150k/mo or 14 days late on invoice. We haven't hit that yet but runway looks tight if usage continues.

Sam: Onboarding notes — prod rollout for search assistant still in ramp (expected +40% calls), that's the main token pressure. Also they enabled long-context sessions (32k) for a few power users.

Jordan: Ok — immediate asks: 1) quick list of 2 cost mitigations we can propose (non-disruptive), 2) spend forecast slide with 3 scenarios (base, growth, high), 3) one technical quick-win to cut unit cost.

Alyssa: Proposal: 1) enable prefix (KV) caching for the search assistant (saves repeated system prompts) 2) cap max session length for non-admins to 8k by policy (soft-limit with prompt to upgrade). Both low-friction.

Sam: Technical details for caching: we estimate 20–30% token reduction on repeated queries. Implementation: set session cache TTL=24h and add request header X-Redwood-Cacheable. Example call: 

```http
POST /v1/generate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <key>, X-Redwood-Cacheable: true
Body: {"prompt": "...", "session_id": "user-123"}
```

Alyssa: I'll capture expected impact numbers for the deck.

Mike: For the three scenarios (current, +20% ramp, +40% ramp) numbers: current= $41.2k/mo, +20%= $49.4k/mo, +40%= $57.7k/mo — but Helix's new search rollout could push short-term spikes to $80k+/mo while they finish funnel testing.

Luis: If they sign a 6‑month committed reservation (dedicated), we can offer a blended rate that would lower unit cost ~18%. I'll model exact savings if Alyssa gives token breakdown by route/model.

Jordan: Also want a slide with budget alert configuration we recommend. Can someone paste a quick alert rule?

Alyssa: Suggested alert rule: 
- metric: billing.usage.tokens or billing.usage.$ 
- condition: forecasted 7-day spend > 85% of monthly budget OR daily spike > 200% baseline
- actions: email CS lead + auto-create support ticket + slack webhook to #customer-success

onboard-bot: Auto-note: Helix onboarding milestones: data ingestion (done), test agents (50%), prod search flag (expected 2023-11-18).

Sam: Quick technical win #2: quantize embedder model for background indexing (no quality regression expected for their use-case) — should cut embedding cost ~40% for batch jobs.

Jordan: Great. Can someone draft a 1‑slide exec summary and a 1‑slide remediation playbook? I'll assemble.

Alyssa: I'll put slides together. Draft notes: 1) Summary of current spend + forecast table, 2) Risk triggers and recommended alerts, 3) Two remediation plays (KV caching + session caps), 4) Financial upside of 6m commit.

Mike: Slack link to raw billing export: https://redwood.internal/exports/helix-usage-1802.csv (internal)

Luis: I'll run a quick savings calc for 6m commit: need tokens by model (A, B, embedder) — Alyssa pls send.

Alyssa: Sending token breakdown now.

Jordan: Timeline: slides by Friday 3pm PT, dry-run Friday 4pm PT. If anyone sees an urgent invoice/payment risk, flag it here immediately.

Mike: noted. Adding a budget alert to their account for a 72hr pulse check.

Sam: I'll add a snippet to the enablement doc on how to toggle session caps in the console. Link: https://redwood.docs/onboarding/session-policies

Luis: Payment team will follow up with finance owner at Helix today.

Jordan: Thanks team — we should be able to present a solid QBR with these plays. :thumbsup:
